tips_en: Read DreamX first: it offers the clearest standalone contribution—reusing a frozen video-diffusion backbone as a universal latent-action interface—with strong cross-embodiment transfer and a 96.7% real-world success rate. The omni-modal routing paper provides the systems-level framework in which DreamX-like policies could serve as specialized candidates, while Kling’s semantic contracts, reward models, and evaluators could supply outcome signals for those routers.
tips_zh: 建议先读 DreamX：它以冻结的视频扩散骨干模型充当通用潜在动作接口，贡献集中且清晰，并实现了强跨具身迁移和 96.7% 的真实世界成功率。全模态路由论文则提供了系统级框架，可将 DreamX 类策略作为候选模型进行选择与协调；Kling 论文中的语义契约、奖励模型和评估器还可为路由器提供结果信号。
